symptom: When the scheduler host has no Python interpreter containing both apscheduler and pytest, focused-test command discovery can either embed a locally disproven interpreter or abort code and QA task construction before a remote worker receives the task.
root_cause: Focused-test interpreter discovery treated scheduler-local dependency availability as a task-construction requirement instead of using verified local interpreters only as a preference and preserving a portable command for the remote execution worker.

executable_template.applicability_check: Force every scheduler-local focused-test interpreter probe to return false and confirm code and QA task prompt construction still returns text containing a runnable remote-worker pytest command.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Select only locally verified interpreter candidates; when none qualifies, emit python3 as the portable remote-worker executable while preserving the exact focused pytest target and all existing explicit overrides.
executable_template.rollback_plan: Revert the interpreter fallback and its focused regression together; if remote workers cannot resolve python3, configure MODSTORE_SELF_MAINTENANCE_FOCUSED_TEST_COMMAND explicitly before re-enabling unattended self-maintenance.
